The typo is fixed and committed as one commit, `f0177a1`, so `git revert f0177a1` undoes all of it.

- **What changed:** "wholsale" appeared once in each file. I changed it to "wholesale" in row R2510-002 in October, R2511-004 in November and R2512-003 in December. Nothing else changed.
- **Everywhere:** I searched the whole repo, including the January file in `inbox/`, and there were no other copies. January wasn't touched.
- **Check:** `scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit, and all three files are 2025, so it did check them.
- **Commit message:** your rule is to start messages with the data month, but this commit covers three months. I started it with `2025-10..2025-12:`. If your import log can only group by a single month, tell me which one to use and I'll reword the message.
